hooks.title: กระสือแถวบ้าน

hooks.synopsisContinuity: The alley loses power, a red light moves through the banana garden, and the newly occupied rental house is implicated.

hooks.title: นาคานคร

She stands still on an old stone landing by the Mekong at violet twilight, with ruined Thai temple spires half-hidden in mist. A small old naga pendant hangs from her hand near her chest; the water is dark and calm. Her face and the space immediately behind her shoulder occupy the upper central half. timeline.dialogue: ใครเรียกชื่อฉัน?

timeline.audio: Low river resonance and moving water; no unseen voice.
